summary: This directory serves as the root for document processing and generation logic. It orchestrates the lifecycle of document construction, from initializing contextual data and path resolution to content building, translation, and rendering, ensuring a cohesive pipeline for artifact management.
responsibilities: Coordinate document construction and processing workflows
Manage the initialization and configuration of document contexts
Facilitate content translation and localized document generation
Resolve file system paths for organizational consistency
Translate raw data into structured, renderable formats
relationships: The initialization phase establishes the foundational state and context used by the construction and translation services.
Content builders assemble structured hierarchies that are subsequently prepared for translation and final rendering.
Path resolution logic maps the generated document components to specific storage locations defined by system configuration.
The translation process integrates with the content building workflow to ensure documents are localized before being finalized.
designDecisions: Use of builder patterns for hierarchical structure assembly
Centralization of path resolution to decouple file system dependencies
Strict separation between document discovery, transformation, and rendering
Configuration-driven logic for context initialization and path mapping
